items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: we got a job to go to Frisco with a drummer with me Curtis Molesby

ctx.x: And what kind of place was the cabaret? Cabaret. I clubbed his lap, just like Lee's.

And they closed him up at the same time, and they mixed dancing. But he listened at him, you know, see, he didn't get smart about him, they said. But they kept telling him not to do it, and he done it, but he just come and closed him up. He didn't have to close the place. Took his license. So after that, wasn't work around there. There wasn't nothing happening. So I went over to the Southern Pacific. They say they wanted some men to work over in the yard. Because I wasn't a man. I was a boy. I was 19 years old.…
